TLS 1.2 or higher for all SaaS systems and the cloud tenant. Gap: spreadsheets with ISIR data are emailed to the servicer without message encryption.

OS patches install automatically on staff endpoints and lab PCs. Gap: firewall firmware and cloud workloads are patched irregularly.
